summary: Iteration 15 verification of (1) tab visibility in ProgramEditor, (2) simplified programs schema (2 programs, removed problem/overview/testimonials), (3) cache invalidation hook. All 3 features working as specified. Backend: 9/9 pytest passing. Frontend admin: tabs visible (156x54 + 75x54), Beginner Card tab fully prepopulated, Beginner FAQ tab shows 12 Q/A entries, Intermediate FAQ shows 10. Public /programs renders Training Programs hero + Choose Your Level with 2 cards (₹2999 x2, 4 Weeks x2, View Full Details x2) + Foundational Program link + Everyone Here Started Somewhere carousel + Thoughtfully Designed Learning Library (3 items). Beginner detail page (via internal state click) shows correct hero (BEGINNER LEVEL eyebrow, H1 'Strong & Mobile — Beginner', tagline, pills, floating ₹2999, START PROGRAM), FAQ section with all 12 questions, Download App section. CONFIRMED: Why Progress Stalls / What You'll Develop / Vikram sections all gone (count=0). CACHE INVALIDATION verified end-to-end: PUT new tagline via API → dispatch 'content-invalidated:programs' event → sentinel TEST_CACHE_INVAL_TAGLINE_V15 visible on /programs within 2.5s (no reload needed). Tagline restored to original.
critical_code_review_comments: useContent hook now exports invalidateContent(key) — admin pages correctly dispatch the CustomEvent after PUT. Cache TTL also reduced to 60s as a safety net. Clean separation of concerns.
ProgramEditor uses 'card' as state key for the 'Program Details' tab (legacy from previous 4-tab schema). Cosmetic but consider renaming to 'details' for parity with the visible label.

TrainingProgramsPage detail view is state-based (selectedProgram), not URL-routable — visiting /programs/beginner directly returns empty body. Not a regression vs spec (user pasted the same internal-routing design), but it means detail pages have no deep-link / SEO benefit. Worth flagging if SEO becomes a concern.
Modal in ProgramEditor still lacks role='dialog'/aria-modal (carried over from prev iter). Minor a11y.
seed_data_creation: None new. Used TEST_CACHE_INVAL_TAGLINE_V15 transiently on beginner.tagline for cache test and TEST_V15_TAGLINE in pytest round-trip — both restored to 'Ready to level up from the basics?' before exit. Verified DB final state via curl.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_programs_v15.py — exactly 2 programs (beginner/intermediate), beginner faq=12, intermediate faq=10, price=₹2999, duration=4 Weeks, no problem/overview/testimonials. Programs detail is state-based not URL-routable; reach it by clicking 'View Full Details' from /programs (use page.get_by_text('View Full Details').first.click(force=True)). Cache invalidation works: invalidateContent(key) clears localStorage + dispatches window CustomEvent 'content-invalidated:<key>'; useContent listens and refetches. To test manually: page.evaluate("window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('content-invalidated:programs'))"). Razorpay still blocked — do not test payment.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 3 features verified working as designed. Previous-iter code review comment about 5-min cache TTL is now addressed (TTL=60s + invalidateContent hook). Previous-iter rich schema (problem/overview/testimonials) has been intentionally removed per user's pasted code; backend seed re-seeded to match (2 programs only, beginner=12 FAQs, intermediate=10 FAQs).
